name: SonderMind Provider Network
one_liner: Free-to-join insurance billing platform and therapist directory with premium reimbursement rates and VA partnership.
short_description: SonderMind is an insurance billing platform and therapist directory that helps mental health providers accept insurance, manage billing, and attract clients.
long_description: SonderMind is a mental health platform that connects therapists with clients while handling insurance credentialing, billing, and practice management. The platform is completely free for providers to join—therapists sign on as independent contractors and receive bi-weekly payouts with same-day payment options available. SonderMind offers premium in-network reimbursement rates and helps therapists get credentialed with major insurers including Aetna, Anthem, BCBS, Cigna, and UnitedHealthcare. The platform also accepts HSA, FSA, EAP, Medicare, and Medicare Advantage. Notably, SonderMind is an in-network VA provider where the VA covers 100% of costs for veterans with a valid referral. SonderMind also provides continuing education resources and a built-in provider directory for client matching.
best_for: Therapists wanting free insurance credentialing and billing support
Providers seeking premium in-network reimbursement rates
Clinicians wanting to serve VA beneficiaries (100% covered)
Mental health practitioners building private practices
not_for: Providers wanting to only accept self-pay clients
Those seeking deep telehealth platform features

faqs.a: Yes, SonderMind is completely free for therapists to join. Providers sign on as independent contractors and receive bi-weekly reimbursement payouts with an option for same-day payment.
SonderMind accepts most major insurance including Aetna, Anthem, BCBS, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, and many regional carriers. They also accept HSA, FSA, EAP, Medicare, and Medicare Advantage.

faqs.q: Does SonderMind work with the VA?
faqs.a: Yes, SonderMind is an in-network VA provider. With a valid VA referral, therapy is 100% covered by the VA at no cost to veterans, available in all 50 states.

faqs.q: How much do clients pay for SonderMind therapy?
faqs.a: With in-network insurance, clients typically pay a copay between $0-55+ depending on their plan. Self-pay rates range from $45-183 per session depending on session type, length, and provider credentials.
